_comment: eBay category sourcing verticals — the reusable, config-driven demand intake (spec maddi-ebay-category-sourcing). Each row opens ONE vertical's eBay supply tap; adding a row opens a vertical with NO code change (the real-estate 360/virtual-tour row is the reuse acceptance test). ebay_category_id: eBay leaf (Camera Drones ~179697, still to be confirmed live — null = no category scoping, rely on seed queries + the demand_gate facet screen). condition_ids: null = new + used (Lee 2026-08-27), [1000] = new only. gate_category: the demand_gate.classify category a kept row must match (the de-DJI'd drone screen).
